title: Private press and sealed round barriers
summary: Step 6 implemented in dev6: sender-scoped addresses, deterministic staged delivery, strict frames, caps and byte-identical replay.
invariants: Use PRESS_ROUNDS in data/game.conf, default 3; only movement phases have press. Each active power has its own independently shuffled permutation of active powers every round, including self. Draws may coincide by chance. No order-call list.

Each player receives detached public/own state and that player's list and inbox only. All calls collected before delivery. Mail from round k becomes visible in round k+1; last round feeds order call. New movement phase has empty inbox. No delivery receipts, bounce notices, or warnings.

Source contract for press: source~press(view) returns array(status, raw string); view ROUND, ROUNDS, PLAYER_LIST, INBOX. Movement orders view INBOX only. Missing or malformed recognized SEND block drops all mail atomically. Non-OK source statuses deliver nothing.

Parse case-insensitive SEND TO: <numbers> / MESSAGE: / END MESSAGE. Resolve using sender's original round list, not mutated callback view. Mixed invalid/valid addresses drop entire message. Duplicate recipients get one copy. First 6 blocks only; cap each body at 1500 UTF-8 code points; invalid bytes individually counted. CR/LF normalized for framing; original raw bytes logged.

True sender and sorted true recipients stamped in === MAIL <id> FROM <power> TO <powers> === and === END MAIL <id> ===. Prefix body lines that begin === with > . Never block or filter player behaviour; log syntactic injection markers only, no penalty.

Sort senders, keep original SEND block order, sort recipients. IDs deterministic; reverse insertion delivery yields identical bytes. Park-Miller PRNG initialized from logged game seed; log every list with pre-draw PRNG state.

DIPLOG|2 has P in META; logs PRESS_ROUND, PLAYER_LIST, PRESS_CALL (raw hex output), PRESS_PARSE, MAIL_DROP, MAIL_CUT, MAIL, PRESS_END, PRESS_TOTAL. Replay regenerates routing, delivery and adjudication from logged raw calls and compares complete bytes. Existing DIPLOG|1 P=0 gate remains exact.

Step 7 must add full input/output text contract, MEMORY and private reasoning, runtime profiles, real timeouts, token counts etc. Press stubs are trusted in-process test code, not a sandbox or competitive prompts.
procedure: Read REQ-00006103, REQ-00006117, REQ-00006121 for controlling rules.
rexx tools/game.rex run SCRIPTED 7 press.log; rexx tools/game.rex replay press.log press-replay.log (new log paths).
sh tests/run.sh with ALCHEMY_REPO_ROOT and native r13196. Read evidence/PRESS-QUALIFICATION.md.
